info.description: Releases course content gradually instead of all at once. Set the schedule per course from Course Details → Schedule Unlock, or per item from its three-dot menu.

enforce.label: Apply unlock rules to learners
enforce.hint: Off means you can set rules up and preview them without anything changing for learners. Turn it on when the schedule is ready to go live.

warning.suffix: . Some may be old or unfinished — they have never affected learners. Switching this on applies all of them at once, so review them in each course first.

schedule.title: Default schedule
schedule.description: What the per-course scheduler starts from. Every course can still override it.
